known_issues.issue: A 4:3 scene on a 19.5:9 phone leaves roughly 295 CSS px of flat plum between the scene and the controls. It is collected into one region with the controls at thumb level, so it reads as background rather than breakage, but portrait uses the screen far less elegantly than landscape.
known_issues.recommendation: Landscape is the better experience (92% screen use, canvas nearly full-bleed). Worth telling Klaudia to rotate.
